confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Vietnamese highland tourist-town pricing, not from live listings or menus. Food and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation and wine, which are wider bands. Wine is a judgement based on the restaurant-price relationship to beer. The FX rate comes from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page, which I did not open directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: mid-sized Vietnamese tourist cities such as Nha Trang and Hue, with prices adjusted down slightly for Da Lat's lower-cost accommodation and food relative to coastal resort towns. Cocktail and wine are set relative to the local beer price.
